changelog: Returning browser sessions now attach the stored JWT before early `/api/settings` and `/api/time` requests.
Startup modules no longer send protected API requests without Bearer before the full auth wrapper is ready.
changelog_es: Added an early `/api/*` fetch guard so modules that initialize before the full auth wrapper do not send protected requests without Bearer.
Returning browser sessions now attach the stored JWT before early settings/time requests, removing startup 401 noise and avoiding stale pre-auth component state
